body.launch_command: --model-path /models/glm53 --served-model-name glm53flash --trust-remote-code --model-impl sglang --device npu --attention-backend ascend --quantization modelslim --load-format safetensors --dtype bfloat16 --kv-cache-dtype bfloat16 --tp-size 8 --ep-size 8 --pp-size 1 --moe-a2a-backend deepep --deepep-mode auto --deepep-dispatcher-output-dtype int8 --page-size 128 --context-length 263296 --max-running-requests 16 --chunked-prefill-size 1024 --mem-fraction-static 0.92 --host <HOST> --port 19084 --disaggregation-mode decode --disaggregation-transfer-backend ascend --disaggregation-bootstrap-port 8998 --disaggregation-decode-allocation-policy early --mamba-radix-cache-strategy extra_buffer --mamba-track-interval 256 --linear-attn-backend triton --speculative-algorithm NEXTN --speculative-draft-model-path /models/glm53 --speculative-num-steps 3 --speculative-eagle-topk 1 --speculative-num-draft-tokens 4 --speculative-attention-mode decode --speculative-moe-a2a-backend deepep --cuda-graph-config {"decode":{"backend":"full","max_bs":16},"prefill":{"backend":"disabled"}} --disaggregation-decode-enable-radix-cache --skip-server-warmup --max-mamba-cache-size 96 --enable-metrics --enable-cache-report
